reasoning_traces.think:
The core principle of the training mission is to maintain temporal consistency and prevent data leakage. Walk-forward temporal partitioning ensures that models are trained on past data and validated on future data without overlap. This prevents the model from learning spurious correlations that would not generalize. The frozen data vintage ensures all components operate on identical data, maintaining alignment between reasoning and intelligence modules. Tau cell leak prevention explicitly avoids using in-season data in pre-kickoff predictions, which would otherwise introduce bias. These primitives form a coherent framework where each component's calibration and validation respects temporal causality, thereby enabling robust inference under uncertainty.
